newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banerj to be auctioned in March - paper.
newsitem.headline: Banerj to be auctioned in March - paper.

text.p: The privatization auction of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj should take place in March next year after two previous sell-off attempts in December were derailed, a financial newspaper said on Monday.

The Central Bank extended its administration of Banerj for another 180 days last week, allowing the bank's privatization process to continue. The move prevented Banerj from being liquidated or turned into a federal bank.

Investment bank Bozano, Simonsen, which was hired in January to administer Banerj on behalf of the Central Bank and ready it for privatization, will continue to run Banerj in the new year, Gazeta Mercantil said.
--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
